title: Financial Analyst
jobDescription: About WeRize Founded in 2019 by Vishal Chopra and Himanshu Gupta, WeRize is building India’s largest full stack fintechplatform for 500 million underserved middle-class customers who live in 5000+ small towns of India. WeRize (Wortgage technologies pvt ltd) also owns RBI registered NBFC subsidiary (Wortgage Finance pvt ltd). This customer segmentis not served by privatesector banks, Insurersand Mutual Fund companies due to their low ticket-size and lifetime value and is dependent on PSU/Govt. banks. PSU/Government banks rarely provide financial products beyond basic savings accounts and these customers lack access to unsecured loans, MSME loans, credit cards, affordable housing loans, loan against property , health and life insurance and investment products. WeRize manufactures innovative unsecured consumer credit, mortgages, loan against property, MSME loans,savings and insurance products designed for this customer base keeping in mind their needs, requirements and purchasing power, with a view to add a layer of financial security to their lives and enable access to credit. While customers in these geographies use smartphones, they need properguidance and support when purchasing the right financial products for themselves. So, a pure digital model doesn’t work for this segment. WeRize has innovated on this front through its ‘Finance ki online dukaan (Social Shopify of Finance)’, a first of its kind social distribution tech platform in the financial services space that educates and enables local financially literate freelancers across these small towns to source business through online and offline channels, recommend the right financial product(s) to customers as well as provide after sales support.These freelancers, who are located in more than 5000+ towns and cities, earn as much as INR 30,000 a month from WeRize in commissions. Our social distribution platform supported by financially literatefreelancers means exceptionally low cost of customer acquisition (CAC) and operations costs compared to both fully digital and on-the-ground financial services providers. Digital conversions among this target group are way lower when comparedto upper income customers in metros and hence pure digital CAC doesn’t workfor this segment. While companies like LIC and Fino Bank also rely on freelancer distribution, they deploy local on-fieldteams/branches to manage freelancers in every city. That resultsin very high CAC and operations costs for such companies. WeRize on the other hand, has been able to acquire, train and manage thousandsof freelancers in 5000+ citiesonly through its tech platform and without any feet-on-street team of its own. This results in highly profitable business model for Werize. To know more about the company, please visit: https://www.werize.com Role Description: The Financial Analyst will be a part pf FP&A team and play a crucial role in analyzing business data and facilitating and fostering investor and business relations. The ideal candidate will have exceptional analytical skills, critical thinking and experience in financial analysis, preparing documentation and supporting analytical tasks. Key Responsibilities: Analyze business data and create detailed financial models to support business decisions and reporting. Prepare comprehensive reports and performance analysis. Assist in due diligence processes and respond to investor queries. Prepare and maintain detailed documentation for all business and investment activities. Develop and update business plans, investment decks, and other relevant materials. Ensure all documentation is accurate, well-organized, and readily accessible. Monitor and report business performance metrics. Support strategic initiatives and special projects as needed. Attributes we are looking for Preferably MBA, Experience 1-3 years Proven experience as a Financial Analyst or similar role, preferably in the investment or financial services industry. Strong analytical skills with expertise in financial modelling, forecasting, and data analysis. Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex business concepts to a variety of stakeholders. Proficiency in business and financial software and tools, such as Excel, Power BI and other analytical platforms. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

title: WeRize - Lead Data Scientist - AI/ML Solution
jobDescription: About The Role You will help solve problems at WeRize across credit/fraud risk, business, collections, customer service, etc through AI/ML techniques. As a key member of the team, you work closely with leadership and business/functional units to manage model lifecycle of build, validate, implement, monitor, and update. Responsibilities Solve business problems across all functions using AI/ML. Ownership of model lifecycle management. Guide and train junior team members. Key Responsibilities Build AI/ML solutions to solve business problems across credit risk, fraud, collections, customer service, and other business functions. Own the complete machine learning model lifecyclefrom problem definition and model development to deployment, monitoring, and optimization. Develop predictive and prescriptive models using structured and unstructured data. Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate business challenges into data-driven solutions. Mentor and guide junior data scientists and analysts. Present analytical insights and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Required Skills 4 to 8 years of hands-on experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or Applied Analytics. Strong proficiency in Python (mandatory) and SQL. Experience building and managing ML models across supervised and unsupervised learning using structured and unstructured data. Hands-on experience with one or more of the following: Credit Risk Scorecards, Fraud Detection, Propensity Models, Optimization, NLP, Classification, Regression, Clustering, and Model Lifecycle Management. Strong analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate business problems into scalable AI/ML solutions. Excellent written and verbal communication skills with experience working directly with business stakeholders. Self-driven, comfortable working in ambiguous environments, and capable of mentoring junior team members. Demonstrable experience in financial services, fintech, banking, or lending with exposure to financial domain-specific model development. (ref:hirist.tech)

title: WeRize - Senior DevOps Engineer - Cloud Infrastructure
jobDescription: Role Description We are looking for a skilled and passionate DevOps Engineer to join our dynamic fintech team. You will play a key role in optimizing our infrastructure, ensuring system reliability, and enabling continuous integration and delivery. This is a hands-on role requiring deep technical expertise, a problem-solving mindset, and strong collaboration skills. Key Responsibilities Monitor and proactively troubleshoot system performance issues. Ensure the security, scalability, and compliance of our cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP). Collaborate with software development teams to enhance application performance and reliability. Design and manage robust CI/CD pipelines using tools like Jenkins, Docker, and Git. Work closely with cross-functional teams to identify and implement cost-optimization strategies. Automate infrastructure using Terraform or AWS CloudFormation (Infrastructure as Code). Implement backup, disaster recovery, and monitoring solutions. Stay up-to-date with the latest cloud services and recommend improvements. Attributes We Are Looking For 47 years of experience in DevOps, build-and-release, or service engineering roles. Strong hands-on experience with AWS (EC2, S3, IAM, ELB, Route53, SNS, CloudWatch) and/or GCP. Excellent scripting skills in Shell, Python, or Perl. Solid understanding of Linux systems, networking, and Nginx. Experience with containers (Docker) and container registries. Familiarity with infrastructure management, performance monitoring tools, and security best practices. Bonus: Experience with Kubernetes or similar container orchestration platforms. (ref:hirist.tech)

title: WeRize - Technical Lead - Java/Spring Boot
jobDescription: We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Technical Lead to build, lead, and mentor high-performing software engineering teams. The ideal candidate will take complete ownership of mission-critical projects, collaborate across functions, and drive technical excellence while contributing to product innovation in a fast-paced, startup-like environment. Key Responsibilities Lead and mentor a team of software engineers to deliver high-quality, scalable products. Own end-to-end delivery of multiple mission-critical projects. Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Business teams to define and execute solutions. Drive technical architecture, design discussions, and system-level decision making. Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to best coding practices and standards. Define and enforce software engineering best practices, agile processes, and CI/CD workflows. Ensure performance, scalability, security, and reliability of applications. Evaluate and adopt new technologies to improve engineering efficiency and product quality. Participate in hiring, onboarding, and mentoring of engineering talent. Required Technical Skills Strong hands-on experience in Java and Spring Boot / Spring Framework. Experience with Microservices architecture. Strong knowledge of RESTful APIs and API design principles. Good understanding of Data Structures, Algorithms, and System Design. Experience with SQL/NoSQL databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, etc.). Hands-on experience with Cloud platforms (AWS / Azure / GCP). Strong knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices. Experience with containerization tools like Docker and Kubernetes (preferred). Familiarity with message brokers (Kafka / RabbitMQ). Experience with version control systems (Git). (ref:hirist.tech)

title: Lead Frontend Developer
jobDescription: About WeRize Founded in 2019 by Vishal Chopra and Himanshu Gupta, WeRize is building India’s largest full stack fintech platform for 500 million underserved middle-class customers who live in 5000+ small towns of India. So, a pure digital model doesn’t work for this segment. WeRize has innovated on this front through its ‘Finance ki online dukaan (Social Shopify of Finance)’, a first of its kind social distribution tech platform in the financial services space that educates and enables local financially literate freelancers across these small towns to source business through online and offline channels, recommend the right financial product(s) to customers as well as provide after sales support. These freelancers, who are located in more than 5000+ towns and cities, earn as much as INR 30,000 a month from WeRize in commissions. Our social distribution platform supported by financially literate freelancers means exceptionally low cost of customer acquisition (CAC) and operations costs compared to both fully digital and on the-ground financial services providers. Digital conversions among this target group are way lower when compared to upper income customers in metros and hence pure digital CAC doesn’t work for this segment. While companies like LIC and Fino Bank also rely on freelancer distribution, they deploy local on-field teams/branches to manage freelancers in every city. That results in very high CAC and operations costs for such companies. WeRize on the other hand, has been able to acquire, train and manage thousands of freelancers in 5000+ cities only through its tech platform and without any feet-on-street team of its own. This results in highly profitable business model for Werize. To know more about the company, please visit: https://www.werize.com/ Role Description: We are looking for a highly motivated and visionary Lead Frontend Developer with deep expertise in React.js to spearhead our frontend engineering efforts. In this role, you will not only build seamless, user-friendly web applications but also define architectural patterns, establish engineering best practices, and mentor a growing team of engineers. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional leadership—including Product, Design, and Backend Engineering—to drive the technical roadmap and deliver robust, scalable frontend solutions. Key Responsibilities: Architecture & Development: Lead the design, architecture, and implementation of highly responsive, scalable, and high-performance web applications using React.js. Technical Leadership & Collaboration: Partner with product managers, UX/UI designers, and backend architects to define product roadmaps, technical feasibility, and seamless API integrations. Engineering Excellence: Establish, advocate for, and enforce high code quality standards, comprehensive code reviews, and modern best practices across React and JavaScript ecosystems. Performance & Optimization: Drive critical initiatives for application performance tuning, security hardening, code-splitting, and lazy loading to ensure optimal Core Web Vitals. Testing & CI/CD: Formulate frontend testing strategies (unit, integration, and end-to-end) and optimize automation pipelines alongside the QA team for seamless, continuous deployment. Mentorship: Guide, unblock, and mentor mid-level and junior engineers, fostering a culture of technical growth, innovation, and accountability. UI/UX Stewardship: Collaborate tightly with design teams to champion design systems and component libraries, ensuring a highly polished, unified, and accessible user experience. Attributes We Are Looking For: Experience with React.js: 6+ years of hands-on experience in frontend engineering, with at least 4 years focused on architecting production-scale applications using React.js and its core principles. Mastery of JavaScript/TypeScript: Deep expertise in modern JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, semantic HTML5, and advanced CSS/CSS-in-JS methodologies. Advanced State Management: Proven experience designing state management strategies using Redux, Context API, Zustand, or similar libraries in complex application environments. Tooling & CI/CD: Proficient with modern frontend build tools (Webpack, Vite, Babel), version control (Git workflows), and setting up continuous integration/deployment pipelines. System Design & Responsiveness: Exceptional understanding of responsive design, cross-browser compatibility, and building resilient web architectures. Leadership & Problem Solving: Strong analytical, debugging, and systems-level problem-solving skills, with a proven track record of leading technical projects from conception to launch. Attention to Detail & Design Systems: Passion for converting high-fidelity designs into pixel-perfect frontend code and driving the adoption of reusable component frameworks.
